long_biography.plain_text:
Europe Emirates Group grew from a company-registration practice into a wider corporate-services platform under Oton's leadership. The Dubai firm advises on mainland, free-zone and offshore structures, then supports licensing, bank applications, regulatory compliance, visas and residency. Its model is designed for entrepreneurs and investors entering the UAE or coordinating businesses across jurisdictions.

As chief executive, Oton has also pushed the group toward digital lead management and integrated client service. By 2020, the business was using automation and customer-relationship systems to connect marketing, sales and advisory teams while maintaining jurisdiction-specific guidance. In 2024, he represented the company in a partnership that gave business clients access to multi-currency accounts, digital wallets and cross-border payment tools.
